notes.title: Update#1
notes.content: In today’s update, I’m bringing more advanced ideas for the game. I’ve changed most of my original gameplay concepts to make the experience better and longer. This is only the beginning of something bigger… Stay tuned for the next update to learn more about the direction I’m taking with this game.
